title: The Samurai Who Challenged a Leaf
narration: A samurai challenged a falling leaf. He dashed and swung his blade, and missed completely. The leaf won without a fight.

beats.action: Red maple leaf whips across Ren's face, snapping him into instant comic shock
beats.cause: Autumn gust launches leaf straight across his gaze
beats.payoff: Sets up absurd duel in under a second

beats.action: Ren bends knees low into coil crouch and draws his gleaming katana
beats.cause: Hurt samurai pride locks onto the drifting leaf
beats.payoff: Clear combat anticipation and blade silhouette insert

beats.action: Ren charges across the shrine courtyard with real bent-knee strides and world-locked footsteps
beats.cause: Leaf floats lazily ahead on the autumn wind
beats.payoff: Escalating kinetic pursuit across wide painted world

beats.action: Ren brakes hard into wide lunge and slices air while blade breeze lifts the leaf safely overhead
beats.cause: Aerodynamic air push from his own swing saves the leaf
beats.payoff: Clean comedic reversal as steel cuts empty air

beats.action: The red maple leaf drifts softly down onto the bridge of Ren's nose
beats.cause: Silence after whiff leaves leaf circling straight down
beats.payoff: Close reaction closeup with delicate spring tap on nose

beats.action: Deadpan samurai lowers his blade as the victorious leaf rides away on a final gust
beats.payoff: Memorable comedic hold and autumn closure
